where.if: AND (CONVERT(c.code USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT CAST(c.id AS CHAR) id,c.code,c.name,c.sort_order,c.enabled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p WHERE p.category_id=c.id) product_count,c.created_at FROM category c ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
